events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the tragic death of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Legacy of an icon
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a true visionary. We're looking back at the incredible impact Tupac Shakur had on hip-hop and beyond.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Remembered
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: It's been 56 years since we lost Jimi Hendrix, but his revolutionary guitar work still sounds as fresh and electrifying as ever.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is still on heavy rotation for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: Imagine Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that continues to inspire and resonate across generations. What does it mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Tech & Music Milestone
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Celebration
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of espionage and iconic theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the timeless music and powerful message of John Lennon. His legacy lives on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Eclectic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles delivered 'The White Album' – a sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Queen's Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Musical Evolution Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a significant shift in their sound. A true game-changer.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: This day marks the tragic anniversary of John Lennon's death in 1980.

angles.name: A Poignant Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world fell silent as we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate.
